annotations.title: Check restaurant systems against Maple integrations

description: Use when a restaurant owner or operator asks whether Maple (AI phone answering and phone ordering for restaurants) works with the point-of-sale, online-ordering or reservation systems they use. Pass the system names as plain text. Each one is matched, ignoring case and using common aliases, against the public integrations list on maple.inc. The result says whether Maple lists an integration, with its maple.inc page; names that are not on the list are reported as not listed, never guessed. Read-only: it uses only that public list and needs no account. It does not check live account status or availability for a specific restaurant.

systems.description: Names of the systems the restaurant uses, as the user wrote them, for example ["Toast", "OpenTable", "Foobar POS"].

name: check_restaurant_systems
